messages:
amy_sales: FYI — EdgeWave just submitted a SIG/CAIQ via the intake form. POC scheduled for next Tue. They also have a pricing question about a short pilot + reserved capacity discount. Ticket SIG-2047 created.
intake-bot: New intake submitted: EdgeWave — SIG/CAIQ attached. Ticket SIG-2047. Submitter: jason@edgewave.com. Link: https://internal.redwood/tickets/SIG-2047
raj_security: taking this. Quick Qs: (1) who is our primary contact? (2) what environment will the POC use (prod/dev/sandbox)? (3) any regulated data (PHI/PCI)?
amy_sales: contact is Jason Miller <jason@edgewave.com>. POC will use their dev sandbox hosted in us-west-2. No PHI/PCI — they said logs and product metadata only. They will want BYOK/HSM for key custody.
maria_sec_ops: we support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) via our KMS integration. HSM-level guarantees depend on the cloud provider and customer KMS; we can document supported flows. I'll drop a short note into the ticket with the KMS integration steps.
raj_security: great. For the SIG/CAIQ I need: network diagram (simple), data flow notes, and whether they require e2e encryption of customer uploads at rest. Also please attach their SLA question list if any. I'll take owner of the CAIQ answers. ETA 3 business days unless call required.
amy_sales: attaching customer slide with timelines to the ticket. They asked: can we do a 3-month pilot with 50% off Dedicated for first 60 days, then evaluate reserved pricing? Also want to know if Dedicated can be scoped to single-tenant GPUs for compliance.
kev_bizops: for pilot pricing we normally offer usage credits or upfront trial credits rather than a permanent reserved discount. Reserved discounts require a commit (3/6/12mo). Proposal: offer $X in credits covering ~60 days of expected usage, then discuss reserved commit if POC proves out. Kevin will sync with sales ops for numbers.
owen_engineering: engineering note: enabling BYOK with HSM-backed KMS + Dedicated single-tenant GPU setups will add ~10 business days for infra provisioning (networking + HSM KMS config). If they need on-prem HSM integration there is extra work — estimate after we see their KMS provider.
maria_sec_ops: blocker callouts: (a) they want SOC2 evidence and our last audit — I'll attach the security pack to the ticket. (b) We need to confirm data residency (they asked EU-only for production). For POC it's fine in us-west-2; prod will need eu-west-1.
raj_security: will answer the CAIQ rows that are purely process/controls. For tech controls (KMS/HSM, network segmentation) I'll collaborate with @maria_sec_ops and @owen_engineering. Assigning CAIQ -> raj_security in ticketing queue.
amy_sales: can you also confirm whether Dedicated supports customer-managed network peering (VPC peering) vs private link? Customer prefers peering for simpler routing.
owen_engineering: we support VPC peering + PrivateLink depending on customer infra. For Dedicated we normally recommend PrivateLink for stability, but peering is supported. Will note caveats in the ticket (route tables, IP overlap).
maria_sec_ops: next steps: (1) I will attach SOC2 pack and KMS integration doc to SIG-2047. (2) Raj will post CAIQ answers within 3 business days. (3) Owen to estimate infra lead time and add gating items. (4) Sales to confirm pilot metrics and expected token/throughput for credit sizing.
amy_sales: thanks — I'll ask Jason for expected QPS and dataset size, and push the pilot timeline. Please tag me when CAIQ answers are in so I can share with the customer. :thumbsup:
kev_bizops: noted — I'll draft an agreement template for a 60-day trial credit + optional reserved commit, drop in the ticket.
raj_security: starting CAIQ now. If any item requires a legal or product-policy deviation I'll flag it here.
intake-bot: Ticket SIG-2047 updated: owner=raj_security, status=In Review, due=3 business days.
maria_sec_ops: marking internal label: "sales-pilot:edgewave" and "data-residency:eu-prod" on the ticket.
amy_sales: perfect. I'll set a follow-up in calendar for EOD Thu to check progress.
